title: Add explicit API route definitions with tests
problem_statement: No explicit HTTP route definitions or API surface detected in static analysis, risking incomplete API coverage and unclear interface contracts.
risk_if_unaddressed: Lack of clear API endpoints may cause integration failures and reduce maintainability.
suggested_approach: Define explicit FastAPI route decorators with clear HTTP methods in relevant modules. Add integration tests to cover API endpoints.
success_criteria: All API endpoints are explicitly declared with route decorators.
Automated tests cover all API routes with success and failure cases.
API documentation is generated and validated.

provenance.evidence: No routes detected despite decorator hints in utils/context_vault.py and web/server.py

title: Implement and document testing strategy
problem_statement: No test modules or test routes detected, risking regressions and lower code reliability.
risk_if_unaddressed: Without tests, defects may go undetected and increase maintenance costs.
suggested_approach: Create unit and integration test modules for agent logic and API endpoints. Use existing e2e audit scripts as basis for coverage.
success_criteria: Test coverage metrics meet or exceed 80%.
Tests are integrated into CI pipeline.

provenance.evidence: No test routes or test modules identified in scan

title: Refactor high-complexity modules to reduce import coupling
problem_statement: Modules such as agents/analyst.py have high import counts, increasing complexity and maintenance risk.
risk_if_unaddressed: High coupling may lead to bugs and harder feature additions.
suggested_approach: Analyze dependencies and split functionality into smaller, focused modules where possible.
success_criteria: Import count per module reduced by at least 30%.
